name: qwen-face-swap-v0
purpose: Determine whether generic two-image Qwen editing can perform a recognizable face-identity swap while preserving target composition and body morphology.
decision_rule: Pass as a generic face-swap backend when source_identity_transfer, target_body_preservation, target_pose_preservation, target_scene_preservation, and face_boundary_quality are at least 4 and artifact_severity is at most 2.
fallback: If Qwen fails identity transfer or alters target morphology, evaluate a dedicated swap backend. ReActor is not the default candidate because its current upstream implementation includes an NSFW detector; keep backend selection replaceable.
